summary: Track personal expenses by category and see how much was spent each month.

acceptance: the expense must belong to an existing category
a new expense appears in the list
the list shows every expense, newest date first
viewing an expense that does not exist returns 404
any field can be changed on its own
a deleted expense no longer appears in the list
deleting an expense that does not exist returns 404
a category that still has expenses cannot be deleted
for a month YYYY-MM, shows the total amount and number of expenses
a month with no expenses shows total 0 and count 0
